item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01215","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as 90 seconds per cat, counting only one ear.","case2_error":"Treats the four dogs' combined 1 kg daily consumption as each dog's consumption, multiplying by four again.","reason":"Both confuse a per-individual quantity with a group total, applying the wrong scope to a rate.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01216","case1_error":"Excludes the nine newly received fish from the total before halving, then arbitrarily rounds the resulting half-fish.","case2_error":"Subtracts sold seats from capacity, then subtracts absentees, using unsold seats as the attendance baseline.","reason":"The first omits additions to the population; the second substitutes the population's complement for the relevant population.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01217","case1_error":"Reports unsupported $100 despite correct earnings and fuel-cost formulas; also drops necessary parentheses in the profit-per-mile expression.","case2_error":"Omits the $150 fixed rental fee, reporting only mileage charges.","reason":"The first contains an unsupported final value and malformed intermediate relation; the second omits a required cost component.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01218","case1_error":"Provides unsupported 12000 after correctly setting up 3000 + 276 × 48 + 7000, which yields 23248.","case2_error":"Counts the unicorns twice, separately and within the Godzilla-plus-unicorn subtotal.","reason":"The first supplies an unexplained wrong number after a correct formula; the second explicitly double-counts a component.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01219","case1_error":"Equates current practice P with past practice P/2, then unjustifiably concludes x = 2.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported 40% after stating the correct percentage formula; the requested percentage is 20%.","reason":"The first explicitly asserts a false relation between past and current quantities; the second supplies a wrong final number without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
